title: The Hughes group's CIA covert actions, the Glomar Explorer and the Kennedy killings
summary: Matthew Pines tells of The Hughes group's CIA covert actions, the Glomar Explorer and the Kennedy killings, about 1960s-1970s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And this was the same group that was doing all the covert actions for the CIA, the Lamar Explorer, etc. And potentially even doing the hits

plain: A researcher, Matthew Pines, says that a group around the businessman Howard Hughes did covert work for the CIA, the US spy agency, in the 1960s and 70s, including the project involving a ship called the Glomar Explorer. He adds that this same group may even have carried out killings, which the story links to the Kennedy assassinations. If true, it would mean a private group close to these secrets was also doing the government's darkest work.
